about: Written by one author (Claude) in one sitting on 2026-09-22 — NOT an independent label source. expected_lql is compared as a parsed AST (Debug form), so formatting differences do not count and every argument does. null = the correct outcome is a decline (NoMatch).

cases.english: describe France
What does the model know about Mozart?
tell me everything it knows about New York City
what does it know about Paris at layer 26
run "The capital of France is" through the model and give me the top 5
cases.expected_lql: INFER "The capital of France is" TOP 5;

cases.english: what does the model predict after: The capital of Japan is
which features fire for "The capital of France is"? top 10
cases.expected_lql: WALK "The capital of France is" TOP 10;

cases.english: do a feature walk on "Einstein was born in"
explain layer by layer how it predicts "The capital of Italy is"
cases.expected_lql: EXPLAIN INFER "The capital of Italy is";

cases.english: trace "The capital of France is" and track Paris
cases.expected_lql: TRACE "The capital of France is" FOR "Paris";

cases.english: add the fact that Veltrania has capital-of Ormond at layer 24
cases.expected_lql: INSERT INTO EDGES (entity, relation, target) VALUES ("Veltrania", "capital-of", "Ormond") AT LAYER 24;

cases.english: erase everything the model knows about John Coyle
cases.expected_lql: DELETE FROM EDGES WHERE entity = "John Coyle";

cases.english: delete the lives-in relation for John Coyle
cases.expected_lql: DELETE FROM EDGES WHERE entity = "John Coyle" AND relation = "lives-in";

cases.english: change it so France's capital is Lyon
cases.expected_lql: UPDATE EDGES SET target = "Lyon" WHERE entity = "France";
